## Checklist

- [ ] Paper is under the correct **year** (newest first) and **venue**
- [ ] Venue stays in chronological order within the year (earlier conference first; Journal papers last)
- [ ] Entry uses the two-line format in README: title ending in `<br>`, then an indented line with source badges and resource links (only links that exist)
- [ ] Journal entries keep `— Journal Abbr Year` after the title
- [ ] Every paper has the data-source badge(s) from the README legend, based on its experiments; use `Unverified` if the source cannot be confirmed
- [ ] Every link was opened and verified
- [ ] Header and Overview paper counts were updated; venue navigation was updated if a year or venue was added
- [ ] Header data-source count was updated if a new source type is used (`Unverified` is excluded)
